question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        l.name as league,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
),
team_total_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(wins) as total_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team_api_id,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_api_id ASC) as rn
    FROM team_total_wins
)
SELECT r.league, t.team_long_name as team_name, r.team_api_id, r.total_wins
FROM ranked_teams r
JOIN Team t ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.league

WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        1 as win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        1 as win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
)
SELECT 
    league,
    SUM(win) as total_wins
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM home_wins
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM away_wins
)
GROUP BY league, team_name
ORDER BY league, total_wins
